name: samsung-tv
title: Samsung TV
description: Control a Samsung Smart TV over Wi-Fi: power on and off, switch apps and inputs, and use the TV as an extended Mac display. Not affiliated with Samsung.
author: zmaten

commands.name: turn-on
commands.title: Turn on TV
commands.subtitle: Samsung TV
commands.description: Wake the TV from standby with Wake-on-LAN.

commands.name: toggle-power
commands.title: Toggle TV Power
commands.subtitle: Samsung TV
commands.description: Turn the TV on if it is off, or off if it is on.

commands.name: extend-display
commands.title: Extend Mac Display to TV
commands.subtitle: Samsung TV
commands.description: Turn the TV on and use it as an extended display over AirPlay.

commands.name: disconnect-display
commands.title: Disconnect TV Display
commands.subtitle: Samsung TV
commands.description: Stop using the TV as a display.

commands.name: open-app
commands.title: Open TV App
commands.subtitle: Samsung TV
commands.description: Switch between apps installed on the TV.

commands.name: select-tv
commands.title: Select TV
commands.subtitle: Samsung TV
commands.description: Find Samsung TVs on the network and choose which one to control.

preferences.name: ip
preferences.title: TV IP Address
preferences.description: Optional. The TV is found automatically; set this only if discovery does not work on your network.

preferences.name: mac
preferences.title: TV MAC Address
preferences.description: Optional. Wi-Fi MAC for Wake-on-LAN. Learned from the TV automatically the first time it is on.

preferences.name: airplayName
preferences.title: AirPlay Name
preferences.description: Optional. Name the TV shows under Screen Mirroring. Learned from the TV automatically.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Pairing Token
preferences.description: Optional. Leave empty: the TV asks you to Allow the connection on first use and the token is saved.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
